output.summary: Epiphytic fern native to tropical southeastern Asia, eastern Australia, Hawaii, Polynesia, Christmas Island, India and eastern Africa. Its large, banana-like fronds form a nest that collects water and decaying plant matter. Sprouts are eaten in Taiwan, while young fronds are eaten in Polynesia, often cooked with coconut cream.
output.edibilityNote: Sprouts are stir-fried or boiled in Taiwan; young fronds are eaten in Polynesia, often cooked with coconut cream.
